title: Selling your old bike
instructionsHu: Eladásra hirdetted a régi kerékpárodat, és felhív egy Budapesten élő angol érdeklődő. Mutasd be a biciklit, egyezzetek meg az árban, és beszéljétek meg, mikor nézheti meg. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You have put an advertisement online to sell your old mountain bike for 60,000 forints because you have bought a new one. A man from England who lives in Budapest calls you because he wants to buy a bike for his son.
situation.candidateRole: You are the seller of the bike.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is Mr Wilson, who is interested in buying the bike.
goals: Describe the bike and its condition.
Explain why you are selling it.
Agree on a price with the buyer.
Arrange when and where he can see the bike.
situation.examinerOpening: Hello, I'm calling about the mountain bike you're selling online. Is it still available?

followUpQuestions: Great. Can you tell me a bit more about it? How old is it, and is there anything wrong with it?
Hmm, sixty thousand is a bit too much for me. Would you take forty-five thousand?
OK, that sounds fair. When could I come and have a look at it?

usefulPhrases.en: The brakes are new, but there's a small scratch on the frame.
usefulPhrases.hu: A fék új, de a vázon van egy kis karcolás.

usefulPhrases.en: I'm selling it because I've got a new one.
usefulPhrases.hu: Azért adom el, mert vettem egy újat.

usefulPhrases.en: You can come and see it on Saturday morning.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling about the mountain bike you're selling online. Is it still available?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hello! Yes, it's still available. Are you looking for a bike for yourself?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: No, it's for my son. He's thirteen. Can you tell me a bit more about it? How old is it, and is there anything wrong with it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It's a black and green mountain bike with twenty-one gears, and it's about four years old. It's in very good condition, and I put new tyres on it last spring. There's only a small scratch on the frame.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: That sounds good. Why are you selling it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I've just bought a new road bike, because I've started cycling longer distances with my friends. I don't need two bikes, and there isn't enough space for both in our flat.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Hmm, sixty thousand is a bit too much for me. Would you take forty-five thousand?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'm afraid that's too little, because the tyres are almost new. How about fifty thousand? I can give you my old bike lock too.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: OK, that sounds fair. When could I come and have a look at it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Are you free on Saturday morning? I live in the thirteenth district, near Árpád híd metro station. We could meet in front of the station at ten, and your son could try the bike.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Saturday at ten is perfect. See you then.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Great, see you on Saturday. Goodbye!

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó mind a négy szempontot sorban teljesíti – leírja a biciklit és az állapotát, elmondja, miért adja el, ellenajánlatot tesz és megegyezik az árban, végül pontos időpontot és helyet egyeztet –, közben kérdez is, tehát kezdeményez.
Szókincs: a helyzethez illő kifejezéseket használ (twenty-one gears, in very good condition, a small scratch on the frame, road bike, bike lock), és alkudni is tud (How about …?).

Nyelvhelyesség: a befejezett jelen idő a friss eseményre (I've just bought, I've started) és az egyszerű múlt a lezárt eseményre (I put new tyres on it last spring) helyes, a javaslatok (We could meet …) is hibátlanok.
Érdemes megtanulni: „It's in very good condition”, „I'm afraid that's too little”, „How about fifty thousand?”, „Are you free on Saturday morning?”.
